name: Patrick A. Kohlmann
tagline: Top rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney in San Jose, California

about: Patrick A. Kohlmann is the managing partner at Temmerman, Cilley, Kohlmann & Norcia. Patrick advises individuals and families in all aspects of wealth transfer planning, including tax-advantaged transfers of assets, multigenerational planning, the taxation of trusts and estates, and business succession counseling. He was Chair of the Executive Committee of the Trusts and Estates Section (TEXCOM) of the State Bar of California (now CLA) from 2015-2016, and served on TEXCOM from 2008-2019. He is a Fellow of the American College of Trust and Estates Counsel, was formerly a member of the Judicial Council’s Probate and Mental Health Advisory Committee, and has consistently been named a Northern California “Super Lawyer,” including recognition as one of the top 100 lawyers in Northern California (2021-2025).
